evidence.detail: Issue author explicitly commented 'This is a manifestation of #7452'; #7452 is OPEN and titled 'Support types properly in search and elsewhere for Split cards, Adventure cards, MDFCs'
type_query() returns GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN type_line ELSE '' END) — only the front face's type is stored in _cache_card
search() queries _cache_card directly via cached_base_query; t:land becomes (type_line LIKE '%land%') on the cached single-face type_line, so MDFCs with land on position 2 are not found

triage.notes: The root cause is that _cache_card.type_line only stores position=1 type data; fixing this for all MDFC/split/adventure searches is the scope of #7452.
